snippets.snippet_text: "Most reviewers were unhappy with their experience overall. Many customers expressed dissatisfaction with the products, citing issues such as outdated content, faulty files, and items not matching descriptions."

"Too obsessed with AI to the point you can not even speak to a real person anymore, even submitted a ticket for someone to get back to me and it has been 3 days, wanted to cancel my account but they re-took a payment and and can not get a refund as I tried for 1 month and it is not for me realised other platforms offering the same thing is cheaper.. overall if you encounter problems all you will be doing is talking to AI chat bots with no real supprt"
"I purchased a year subscription. They are now changing terms less than 4 months in and I am limited to the whole reason I purchased a year. Can't get a refund and am stuck with it."

"I've been a long-time customer of Envato, which is why the new GenAI plans are particularly disappointing. Limiting users to just 10 generations feels out of touch with how these tools are actually used.  Competitors like Kling and Google clearly offer more value for the price. When I reached out for clarification, the response I received was essentially: this is the plan, take it or leave it."

"Envato Elements used to be great value with truly unlimited AI generations included in the subscription. I paid for my plan (annual, no less) expecting that access to continue, as advertised when I signed up.Then, without warning or proper grandfathering for existing subscribers, they slashed it to just 10 generations per month on the standard/Core plan starting February 25, 2026. 10. That's basically nothing—especially since even simple actions like minor edits, upscaling, background removal, retries for bad outputs, or testing variations all count as separate generations."

"I paid $198 for \"unlimited\" AI generations. I got 10.  I subscribed to Envato's annual plan precisely because it offered unlimited AI generations. The pitch was clear: one subscription, all the creative assets you need, AI tools included. I bought in. I paid upfront.  Then, after my money was safely in their pocket, they pulled the rug."
"I had 3 accounts over the years and as a result want nothing to do with this horrendous company. I went to Template Monster for easier access."

"What a huge waste of money.. Avoid buying here, yes they are a great company, but their policies are flawed.  Multiple themes and plugins I have purchased, are no longer available because the author decided to remove them.. So now I have to buy them again?  Literally stupidity. What a huge waste of money."

"I purchased a WordPress theme from Envato Market based on the demo representation and advertised functionality. The demo presentation significantly influenced my purchasing decision, as it showcased specific visual elements and overall design quality that appeared integral to the product."
"Accidentally bought a annual subscription instead of monthly. Sent an e-mail and they immediately gave me a refund. Great customer service!"

possible_subjects: Envato Elements: AI generation limit cut to 10/month on February 25, 2026 for standard/Core plan; previously advertised as unlimited; annual plan priced at $198
Envato Elements: mid-term subscription terms change without grandfathering existing annual subscribers; refund requests blocked
Envato Market: buyer complaints about refund non-response, unauthorized re-billing, products removed by authors after purchase
